user.title: Add a Brrr notification target
user.description: Paste a shared or device-specific webhook URL from the Brrr app. Home Assistant stores the key and sends it in an Authorization header. Enabling Media Library export makes selected images temporarily public under `/local/brrr/`.

data.name: Target name
data.public_media_enabled: Allow temporary public Media Library images

data_description.name: For example, Ivan's iPhone or All devices.
data_description.webhook_key: The URL already contains the secret. It is normalized and never written into automation YAML.
data_description.public_media_enabled: Required only for the Icon/Image from Media Library action fields. Do not select sensitive images.
data_description.public_media_ttl_hours: Expired generated files are removed automatically.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Brrr
reconfigure.description: Leave the webhook field empty to keep the current key.

data.name: Target name
data.public_media_enabled: Allow temporary public Media Library images

data_description.name: Name shown in Brrr actions.
data_description.webhook_key: Use this after rotating the webhook secret in Brrr.
data_description.public_media_enabled: Required only for Media Library image fields.

error.invalid_webhook: Enter a Brrr webhook URL or a key beginning with br_.

abort.already_configured: This Brrr webhook target is already configured.

cleanup_media.name: Clean up public media
cleanup_media.description: Remove all temporary public images generated by Brrr Notifications.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Send a rich push notification through a configured Brrr webhook target.

target_device_ids.name: Targets
target_device_ids.description: One or more Brrr webhook targets that receive the notification.

message.name: Message
message.description: Main notification text. Templates are supported in automations.

subtitle.name: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Line below the title. Brrr does not display it when an icon is used.

icon_url.name: Icon URL
icon_url.description: Public HTTPS image shown in place of the Brrr app icon.

icon_media.name: Icon from Media Library
icon_media.description: Image exported temporarily through Home Assistant. Public media export must be enabled.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Public HTTPS image displayed in the expanded notification.

image_media.name: Image from Media Library
image_media.description: Image exported temporarily through Home Assistant. Public media export must be enabled.

thread_id.name: Thread ID
thread_id.description: Identifier used by iOS to group related notifications.

open_url.name: Open URL
open_url.description: URL or app deep link opened when the notification is selected.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Sound played by Brrr on iPhone or iPad.

interruption_level.name: Interruption level
interruption_level.description: Controls how prominently iOS presents the notification.

volume.name: Critical alert volume
volume.description: Volume from 0 to 1. Only used with the critical interruption level.

filter_criteria.name: Focus filter criterion
filter_criteria.description: Criterion matched by a configured iOS Focus filter.

expiration_date.name: Expiration date
expiration_date.description: ISO 8601 time after which Apple should stop retrying delivery.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.description: Optional subtitle, icon, and expanded image.

delivery_options.name: Delivery options
delivery_options.description: Optional grouping, behavior, sound, and delivery controls.

authentication_failed.message: Brrr rejected the webhook key for {target}.

rate_limited.message: Brrr is rate limiting notifications. Try again in {retry_after} seconds.

timeout.message: Brrr did not respond within {timeout} seconds.
